arguments.code:
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username='paul_mill@gmail.com', password='!T}r*b7')['access_token']

# fetch all albums (already small, but do again cleanly)
all_albums = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_albums.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('albums', len(all_albums))
for a in all_albums:
    print('album', a['album_id'], a['title'], 'songs', a.get('song_ids'))

# gather all song ids
song_ids = []
for a in all_albums:
    song_ids.extend(a.get('song_ids', []))

# de-duplicate while preserving order
seen=set(); unique_song_ids=[]
for sid in song_ids:
    if sid not in seen:
        seen.add(sid)
        unique_song_ids.append(sid)

print('unique_song_ids', unique_song_ids, 'count', len(unique_song_ids))

# fetch each song and its play_count
song_rows=[]
for sid in unique_song_ids:
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    song_rows.append({'song_id': sid, 'title': s['title'], 'album_title': s['album_title'], 'play_count': s.get('play_count')})
    print('song', sid, s['title'], 'play_count', s.get('play_count'))

# pick max
best = max(song_rows, key=lambda x: x['play_count'])
print('best', best)
